# Moodie

> A tiny, deeply configurable animated SVG face for React.

Install: npm install https://github.com/arhxam/moodie-react/releases/latest/download/moodie-react.tgz motion
Repository: https://github.com/arhxam/moodie-react
License: MIT

Minimal usage:

```tsx
import { Moodie } from "@moodie/react";
<Moodie expression="happy" color="#5b6cff" />;
```

Built-in expressions: neutral, happy, excited, sleepy, sad, worried, thinking, love, curious, surprised, focused, cheeky, dizzy, calm, wink, alert.

Shapes: circle, squircle, blob, pebble, diamond.

Expression changes combine body and eye performances. Eye motion also supports notice, glance, squint, wide, and flutter cues; parent-canvas tracking; hover recognition; idle choreography; and right-click blinking.

Main props: expression, defaultExpression, expressions, expressionOrder, onExpressionChange, shape, color, eyeColor, size, eyeScale, eyeDistance, turn, flip, motion, spring, expressionMotion, eyeMotion, blink, pointer, auto, gaze, gazeLimit, clickAction, reaction, reducedMotion, ariaLabel.

Use pointer.target="parent" for full-canvas gaze and eyeMotion.contextMenuBlink for right-click blinking.

Controlled interaction:

```tsx
const [expression, setExpression] = useState("curious");
<Moodie expression={expression} onExpressionChange={setExpression} clickAction="random" />;
```

See the repository's docs/llm-guide.md for the complete model, accessibility rules, custom geometry, and framework notes.
